newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-DONALD ADVISES WARWICKSHIRE HE WILL BE FIT AND READY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-DONALD ADVISES WARWICKSHIRE HE WILL BE FIT AND READY.

text.p: South African fast bowler Allan Donald has told English county side Warwickshire that he expects to be fully fit when he returns as their overseas player next year.
Donald was forced to sit out the deciding third test against India currently being played in Kanpur due to a heel injury.
"A scan has shown that the problem is only bruising," Donald told the Warwickshire. "There is no damage to the bone, but I will be having extra padding in my left boot to prevent a recurrence."
Warwickshire open their championship season against Glamorgan in mid-April.
